evidence_slice: Cornwall Council states that St Lawrence Urban Extension is an allocated housing site for Bodmin, identified as site Bd-UE3 in the Cornwall Site Allocations Development Plan Document and expected to deliver approximately 780 dwellings. Policy Bd-UE3 requires development to accord with a masterplan/concept plan for the entire site. Cornwall Council adopted the St Lawrence Urban Extension Concept Masterplan on 3 May 2023 as a key material planning consideration.

field_evidence.policy_requirement: planning permission is to accord with the masterplan/concept plan for the whole site
